items.text: On 12 medical and surgical wards in Hospitals A to D, does Lean standard work for catheter removal, introduced one hospital per quarter from January 2027, reduce monthly catheter days per 100 patient days by at least 25 percent within six months of each hospital's start, while reinsertion within 72 hours stays below 6 percent?
items.population: Adult inpatients on 12 medical and surgical wards in four hospitals
items.intervention: Value stream mapping and standard work: nurse-driven removal, daily huddle check, flowsheet reminder
items.comparator: Each hospital's own baseline and hospitals not yet started
items.outcome: Monthly catheter days per 100 patient days
items.setting: Regional health system, four acute hospitals

finer: Feasible with one coach and existing data; interesting to the council and wards; novel locally; ethical under the QI screening; relevant after two bacteraemias.
summary: One time-bound improvement aim with a balancing threshold.
